m.IF.bw <- lm(infillBw_logProb ~ infillFw_logProb, data = scores)

length(unique(scores$speaker_id))

## Modeling

```{r}
get_model_coeffs <- function(model, model_name = "Model") {
  # Get summary
  s <- summary(model)
  coefs <- as.data.frame(coef(s))

  # Remove intercept
  coefs <- coefs[rownames(coefs) != "(Intercept)", , drop = FALSE]

  # Format result
  df <- data.frame(
    Predictor = rownames(coefs),
    Beta = coefs$Estimate,
    SE = coefs$`Std. Error`,
    p_value = coefs$`Pr(>|t|)`,
    Model = model_name,
    row.names = NULL,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  return(df)
}
```



```{r}
m.llm.IF.bw <- lmer(duration ~ word_len + uttrSR + age + sex + unigram_logProb + infillFw_logProb + infillBw_logProb + (1|speaker_id), data = scores)
summary(m.llm.IF.bw)
```


```{r}
m.llm.IF.bw.coefs <- get_model_coeffs(m.llm.IF.bw,'w/ Backward Predictability')
```


```{r}
m.llm.IF.bwdecor <- lmer(duration ~ word_len + uttrSR + age + sex + unigram_logProb + infillFw_logProb + decor_infillBw_logProb + (1|speaker_id), data = scores)
summary(m.llm.IF.bwdecor)
```

```{r}
m.llm.IF.bwdecor.coefs <- get_model_coeffs(m.llm.IF.bwdecor,'w/ Decorr Backward Predictability')
```


```{r}
m.llm.IF.pmiFP <- lmer(duration ~ word_len + uttrSR + age + sex + unigram_logProb + infillFw_logProb + infill_pmiFP + (1|speaker_id), data = scores)
summary(m.llm.IF.pmiFP)
```

```{r}
m.llm.IF.pmiFP.coefs <- get_model_coeffs(m.llm.IF.pmiFP,'w/ PMI')
```

```{r}
m.llm.IF.both <- lmer(duration ~ word_len + uttrSR + age + sex + unigram_logProb + infillFw_logProb + decor_infillBw_logProb + infill_pmiFP + (1|speaker_id), data = scores)
summary(m.llm.IF.both)
```

```{r}
m.llm.IF.both.coefs <- get_model_coeffs(m.llm.IF.both,'w/ PMI')
```


```{r}
m.llm.IF.neither <- lmer(duration ~ word_len + uttrSR + age + sex + unigram_logProb + infillFw_logProb  + (1|speaker_id), data = scores)
summary(m.llm.IF.neither)
```

```{r}
lrtest(m.llm.IF.bwdecor,m.llm.IF.pmiFP)
```

```{r}
ModelComp.AIC <- AIC(m.llm.IF.neither,m.llm.IF.bwdecor,m.llm.IF.pmiFP,m.llm.IF.both)
```

### Function-content distinction

```{r}
scores.content <- scores %>%
  filter(CLASS == 'CONTENT')
scores.func <- scores %>%
  filter(CLASS == 'FUNCTION')
```

```{r}
m.llm.IF.decorBw.FuncContentDist.wInt <- lmer(duration ~ word_len + uttrSR + age + sex + unigram_logProb + infillFw_logProb + decor_infillBw_logProb + CLASS * infillFw_logProb  + CLASS * decor_infillBw_logProb + (1|speaker_id), data = scores)
summary(m.llm.IF.decorBw.FuncContentDist.wInt)
```


```{r}
m.llm.IF.pmiFP.FuncContentDist.wInt <- lmer(duration ~ word_len + uttrSR + age + sex + unigram_logProb + infillFw_logProb + infill_pmiFP + CLASS * infillFw_logProb  + CLASS * infill_pmiFP + (1|speaker_id), data = scores)
summary(m.llm.IF.pmiFP.FuncContentDist.wInt)
```


## Visualization

```{r}
durCoefData <- read_csv('models/Study1/model_coefficients.csv')
head(durCoefData)
```
```{r}
durCoefData <- durCoefData %>%
  filter(Construct != "Control")
```


```{r}
durCoefData$significance <- ifelse(durCoefData$p_value < 0.001, "***",
                            ifelse(durCoefData$p_value < 0.01, "**",
                                   ifelse(durCoefData$p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns")))

head(durCoefData)
```

```{r}
durCoefData$Construct <- factor(durCoefData$Construct, levels = c("Unigram Predictability", "Forward Predictability","Planning")) 

durCoefData$Predictor <- factor(durCoefData$Predictor, levels = c("Unigram Predictability", "Forward Predictability","Backward Predictability", "Decorr Backward Predictability", "PMI")) 
```

```{r}
durCoefData.filtered <- durCoefData %>%
  filter(Model != "Model with both") %>%
  filter(Model != "Model with Backward Predictability") %>%
  filter(!(Model == "Model with Backward Predictability" & Predictor %in% c("PMI", "Decorrelated Backward Predictability"))) %>%
  filter(!(Model == "Model with Decorr Backward Predictability" & Predictor %in% c("Backward Predictability", "PMI"))) %>%
  filter(!(Model == "Model PMI" & Predictor %in% c("Backward Predictability", "Decorr Backward Predictability")))
```

```{r}
dur.colors <- c('#009E73','#0072B2','#8E4585')
p1 <- ggplot(durCoefData.filtered,aes(x=Predictor,y=Beta,fill=Construct)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dur.colors) +  # Using hex colors
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Beta-SE,ymax=Beta+SE),position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),width=0.2)+
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = 1.75,size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Model,scales = "free_x") +
  ylab('Model Coefficients') +
  xlab('Key Predictors') +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color = "black"),  # x-axis text
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),  # y-axis text
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),  # x-axis title
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),  # y-axis title
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),  # plot title
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),  # facet labels
    legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10))
```

# Define custom aesthetics for each group
pred.FwClassInt <- ggpredict(m.llm.IF.decorBw.FuncContentDist.wInt, terms = c("infillFw_logProb", "CLASS"))
int.p1 <- ggplot(pred.FwClassInt, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group,linetype=group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#C51B7D","#E58D0A")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dotted","solid")) +
  labs(x = "Forward Predictability \n (log transformed)", y = "Predicted Duration (s)") +
  guides(color = "none", linetype = "none", fill = "none") +  # <- kills legend

    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),  # y-axis title
